title: Nutella Stuffed Brown Butter Sea Salt Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: The best nutella stuffed chocolate chip cookies made with nutty brown butter and a sprinkle of sea salt. Sweet, indulgent, and crowd-pleasing.

steps.instruction: Whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl. Set aside.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Continue cooking until butter browns and gives off a nutty aroma, then remove from heat and transfer to a bowl to cool.
Using an electric mixer, mix the browned butter with both sugars until combined.
Beat in the egg, egg yolk, vanilla extract, and yogurt until smooth.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Cover and chill dough for 2 hours (or 20–30 minutes in freezer if needed).
Roll about 1 1/2 tablespoons of dough into a ball.
Flatten dough, place 1 teaspoon chilled Nutella in center, and wrap dough around it.
Place dough balls on a baking sheet 2 inches apart and gently flatten tops.
Bake for 9–11 minutes until edges are golden but centers are soft.
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes, then sprinkle with sea salt.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
